# Answer-level evaluation (M6): how to run it

**Status: not yet run.** No numbers exist yet; the report is generated by the run itself. The scaffolding is tested
with fakes only (`backend/tests/unit/test_answer_eval.py`, `test_tracing.py`).

## Before the first run

1. The owner finishes the temporal review (`data/domain/temporal/v1/review.human.jsonl`, decision D11) and, for the
   domain questions, reference answers and gold chunk ids exist in the gold JSONL format (`evaluation/answer_metrics.py`).
2. A verified public-corpus workspace holds the demo corpus (decision D1: judge calls carry evidence).
3. A judge model is chosen from a different family than the generator, and pinned (`EVAL_JUDGE_MODEL`).
4. The `eval` group is installed. `uv sync` would remove the `ml` group, so install the locked versions without
   syncing:
   ```bash
   uv export --frozen --no-hashes --no-default-groups --group eval --no-emit-project > "$TEMP/eval-reqs.txt"
   uv pip install -r "$TEMP/eval-reqs.txt"
   ```

## Commands (from `backend/`, Git Bash, after `. ../scripts/dev-env.sh`)

```bash
docker compose -f ../infra/compose.yaml up -d postgres qdrant

# Gold items from the reviewed temporal set (read-only on the review file).
uv run --no-sync mezvuat-exp export-gold --out ../data/domain/temporal/v1/gold.jsonl

# Mezvuat's metrics only (no judge calls): a cheap first pass.
uv run --no-sync mezvuat-exp answer-eval --items ../data/domain/temporal/v1/gold.jsonl \
  --workspace <public workspace id> --no-ragas --out ../docs/eval/answer_eval

# With RAGAS behind the pinned judge (Groq free tier: slow down rather than pay, D4).
uv run --no-sync mezvuat-exp answer-eval --items ../data/domain/temporal/v1/gold.jsonl \
  --workspace <public workspace id> --judge-model <judge model id> --judge-backend direct \
  --out ../docs/eval/answer_eval

# Through ModelMesh, also queueing the labels for POST /v1/feedback/batch (live integration only).
uv run --no-sync mezvuat-exp answer-eval ... --judge-backend modelmesh --post-feedback

docker compose -f ../infra/compose.yaml stop postgres qdrant
```

`MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI` comes from `scripts/dev-env.sh` (SQLite under `X:/mezvuat-cache/mlflow`). Browse with
`uv run --no-sync mlflow ui --backend-store-uri "$MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI"`.

Outputs: `docs/eval/answer_eval/results.json` and `report.md`, an MLflow experiment `answer-eval` (one parent run,
one nested run per retrieval configuration, rows and Langfuse trace ids as artifacts).

## Langfuse (optional, decision D3)

Set `LANGFUSE_HOST`, `LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY` and `LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY` in `.env`. Content is masked before export
unless `LANGFUSE_CAPTURE_CONTENT=true`. With the keys unset, nothing is traced and everything else works.
